claim: That "Unsafe image content detected" warning should have a change : r/bing
summary: That annoying "Unsafe image content detected" warning with the dog image should have this change: Instead of say "Please try again with another prompt" should say "Do you want to see the content anyway?", asking to the users if they want to see the content with 2 options: Yes and no but that question would be only for users over 18 years old.
